snippet.title: Okinawa Journal - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Okinawa Journal is a fixed perspective point-and-click narrative game set during the summer of 2000 in the serene yet mysterious landscapes of Okinawa. You step into the ethereal role of Kami, a guardian angel tasked with guiding Haruki, a struggling journalist, as he delves into the baffling disappearance of a beloved actress.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494660/Okinawa_Journal/

Wishlist on Steam. Coming soon for PC and Steam Deck.

Music by Sky Productions - A Forgotten Dynasty.

2025 Miga Games
